platforms.name: Uber Eats
platforms.summary: Public store pages publish the whole menu with USD prices and the branch's street address as schema.org data, so each price is tied to one US branch.
evidence: Prices read from real US store pages in every live run since 37708779121 (167 to 335 menu items per page).
Store links come from robots.txt-declared sitemaps and brand pages. Non-US country sections are skipped without a request.
A few store pages answered with a challenge. Those are counted as blocked and not worked around.

platforms.name: DoorDash
platforms.summary: Branch discovery works, but store pages answer datacenter requests with a Cloudflare challenge, so no DoorDash branch price could be read from a server.
evidence: 24 of 24 store-page requests across five runs returned 403 “Just a moment…”.
131 per-state store sitemaps are readable (California alone lists 106,228 store URLs).
/business/…/menu pages show prices DoorDash labels “estimated based on your predicted location”, so they are not used as branch prices.
In your own browser, the capture bookmarklet below can read a store page you open.

platforms.name: Grubhub
platforms.summary: Grubhub's restaurant pages are drawn by JavaScript and publish no prices. MenuPages, a Grubhub-owned menu site, publishes the same restaurants' menus with prices and links back to each Grubhub listing.
evidence: Lou Malnati's Pizzeria, 6456 S Cicero Ave, Chicago (Grubhub ID 434510): 162 priced listings, accepted because the MenuPages page links to that Grubhub ID (run 37741487660).
MenuPages' restaurant sitemap lists 28,133 pages, a subset of Grubhub. The Buffalo Grove Lou Malnati's (ID 517712) is not listed.
Grubhub has no /sitemap.xml (404) and its homepage links no restaurants.
